hypothesis: The current blocker is an elaboration/port-binding error, not a datapath or capability-bit bug: rtl/rv32i5.sv instantiates u_branch_predictor with the stale local names lookup_pc / pred_taken / pred_target, while the frozen interface of module branch_predictor (per the planner-frozen contract used by the rest of the design) exposes bp_lookup_pc / bp_pred_taken / bp_pred_target / bp_btb_hit. Icarus therefore aborts with 'port ... is not a port of u_branch_predictor' during elaboration, so no simulation or capability probe ever runs. Secondary risk: the repeated 'sorry: constant selects in always_* processes are not currently supported (all bits will be included)' messages at two source locations indicate array-element writes indexed by a constant inside an always block (typically a register file or a cache/BTB array); these are non-fatal today but silently degrade to 'all bits included', which can corrupt state once the design does elaborate, so those indexed writes should be converted to explicit per-element always_ff blocks or packed vectors. Fix mechanism: rewrite the branch-predictor instantiation in the top level to bind the contract port names (and connect bp_btb_hit, using it in the IF-local prediction mux), leaving branch_predictor.sv's frozen ports untouched, then remove constant-index array writes.
